subject: general
question: Cyanocobalamin is a man-made form of ________ vitamin.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vitamin B12**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cyanocobalamin **is a man-made form of **Vitamin B12.**
 
• It's used to treat and prevent vitamin B12** deficiency anaemia** (when you have low levels of this vitamin in your body).
 
• Your body requires vitamin B12 to make** red blood cells**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vitamin B2 - (****Riboflavin**) helps break down proteins, fats and carbohydrates.
 
• **Vitamin B6** - **pyridoxine**, is a water-soluble vitamin found naturally in many foods, as well as added to foods and supplements.
 
• **Vitamin ****B1 - ****Thiamin (thiamine)** is a water-soluble vitamin, as are all vitamins of the B complex.
